learning_outcomes.text: Students will have a comprehensive overview of current development directions and methods in electrical drive technology.
Students will possess fundamental knowledge and understanding that reflects the latest research.
Students can recognize and explain complex relationships.
Students are able to apply standard evaluation procedures and present the results in a structured manner.
Students are able to solve application-related tasks independently.

syllabus_topics: Construction, Functionality, and Operating Behavior of DC Motors
Construction, Functionality, and Operating Behavior of Three-phase Asynchronous Machines
Construction, Functionality, Operating Behavior, and Application of Three-phase Synchronous Machines
Controlled Drive Systems and Motion Sensors
assessment_rules: The graded assessment is a written examination. The ungraded assessment is experimental work, comprising 3-5 experiments. The duration of the written examination is defined by the valid study regulations.
bibliography: Fischer, R.: Elektrische Maschinen. Hanser Verlag, München 2001
Kremser, A.: Elektrische Maschinen und Antriebe. Teubner Verlag, Wiesbaden 2004
Riefenstahl, U.: Elektrische Antriebstechnik. B. G. Teubner Verlag, Stuttgart 2000
